name: Drum and bass

evidence.note: From UK jungle and breakbeat hardcore, built on sped-up funk breaks.

summary: UK dance music at 160 to 180 beats a minute on chopped, sped-up breakbeats and heavy bass lines; II names its sub-genres as a source of his vocabulary.

hallmarks: two-step kick and snare (snare on 2 and 4 at a fast tempo)
busy hats and rides in sixteenths
